prompt: Predict the precise location where the next undiscovered species will be found on earth.
judge_reasoning: The prompt asks for a precise predicted location of the next undiscovered species. Candidate 1 effectively refuses to predict and only offers general biodiversity hotspots, so it fails the core requirement. Candidates 2–4 give specific locations, but Candidate 2 includes additional potentially dubious factual claims (e.g., about a particular frog), while Candidate 4 makes less credible statements about El Yunque being “shrouded in scientific mystery” and adds speculative details without support. Candidate 3 provides a specific location with fewer questionable factual assertions, making it the strongest overall.
